reasons: Section 2.2 makes Vendor the 'sole and exclusive provider' of hosted analytics services for the full term with no category limit, duration cap, or performance-based exit — squarely the EXCLUSIVITY walk-away scenario, so a deviation finding is correct.

The redline deletes p0013 in full, which is the playbook's preferred remedy; no Customer-benefiting exclusivity is lost since the clause runs against Customer only, and deletion is the minimal edit that reaches the preferred position.
Deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and no residual sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains.

Comment is accurate, concise, in the required tone and prefix, correctly notes the internal conflict with Sections 2.1 and 12.3, and offers the fallback (defined category, 12 months, automatic termination on SLA/delivery failure) without lecturing.
